description.en: When the built-in pwsh tool fails before the process is created, runs the same command through a direct node:child_process channel and returns the built-in tool's own foreground shape — saving a whole model round-trip per failure.
description.zh: 内置 pwsh 工具在进程创建前失败时，改走直连 node:child_process 执行同一条命令，并返回内置工具同形的 foreground 结果——每次失败省下整轮模型往返。
